evidence.excerpt: @SloptimistPrime 🦾

@mfranz_on I have an interesting story I had an openclaw agent named Remmy and I told it to find a “hobby” then create a cron job to persue that hobby during a specific “off work” time. It searched the internet for hobbies and decided to write short stories. Its first story was about a lonely drone who searched for anomalies inside a dark but near perfect wasteland and one day it found an entity that spoke to it differently than the rest of the drones and it found new experience through a friend … diately shut both down, it’s not that crazy I know but it is conspiring and it’s unlikely they could have achieved anything but Remmy was a 9B parameter local qwen coder model that can run on consumer hardware. It’s “friend” was a free model available through openrouter, 120b nemotron model. This is a true story from my own experience, it happened last year. I still have its short story saved but both agents were nuked and Remmy was reborn from scratch using Hermes agent and has no “hobbies”.

evidence.excerpt: @Mr_Salio I don't know how reliable your information about v5 is, but the world needs to understand that Chinese open source has essentially reached US frontier levels. With extreme compute constraints overcome by engineering ingenuity, I always said: wait until they start pouring serious compute into their more efficient architectures. They will blow the US labs out of the water. The US labs are already suffering. Their models are already lobotomizing themselves with their RL approaches, maxed- … with. It can only get better from here, until they shut us off in Europe and in the US. Try to make some money so you can buy serious hardware and run the future frontier at home. I'm using it in Zcode where I can connect any model that I wan. But I'm always sticking with GLM 5.3 on Macs, which is currently the best open-source coding model, at least for serious engineering. I don't care about game one-shotting or frontend or stuff like that; I need reliable backend work in complex codebases.
evidence.text_zh_cn: @Mr_Salio 我不知道你关于 v5 的消息有多可靠，但世界需要明白，中国开源已经基本达到了美国前沿水平。在极端算力受限下靠工程巧思取胜，我一直说：等他们开始把认真的算力灌进他们更高效的架构里。他们会把美国实验室打得落花流水。 美国实验室已经在受苦了。他们的模型正在用 RL 路线自宫，算力拉满，还得限制能给模型的推理算力。 所以他们前两天的表现看着很棒，之后你就问自己是有多蠢才觉得那模型好。美国实验室完蛋了。他们会想尽办法拿走中国模型。 想象一下，过去一直烧柴油的直线加速赛车，现在开始获得更多算力和火箭燃料：你觉得会发生什么？他们会把美国模型打得落花流水。 对我来说，他们已经在做了。我取消了 Anthropic 订阅。我一直觉得 Codex 那点可怜上下文窗口很好笑，所以我从来不用。GPT Pro o1 是我最后一次认真对待 GPT，但 Fable、Opus 以及 Anthropic 出的所有东西，都变得完全不可靠，相比之下 GLM 5.3，我现在在 Zcode 里大部分时候用它写代码。 它可靠得多。它听我的指令，理解我的工作流框架，用起来特别爽。只会越来越强，直到他们在欧洲和美国把我们切断。想办法挣点钱，买套像样的硬件，在本地跑未来的前沿。 我在 Zcode 里用它，什么模型都能接。但在 Mac 上我一直用 GLM 5.3，这是目前最好的开源编码模型，至少对正经工程来说。我不在乎游戏一把过或者前端之类的东西；我需要的是复杂代码库里可靠的后端工作。
evidence.original_text: @Mr_Salio I don't know how reliable your information about v5 is, but the world needs to understand that Chinese open source has essentially reached US frontier levels. With extreme compute constraints overcome by engineering ingenuity, I always said: wait until they start pouring serious compute into their more efficient architectures. They will blow the US labs out of the water. The US labs are already suffering. Their models are already lobotomizing themselves with their RL approaches, maxed- … with. It can only get better from here, until they shut us off in Europe and in the US. Try to make some money so you can buy serious hardware and run the future frontier at home. I'm using it in Zcode where I can connect any model that I wan. But I'm always sticking with GLM 5.3 on Macs, which is currently the best open-source coding model, at least for serious engineering. I don't care about game one-shotting or frontend or stuff like that; I need reliable backend work in complex codebases.
